keys.tanilo_note: Tanilo's signing key. Signs /evaluate and /v1/verify-facts receipts; both routes run the check themselves and neither signs a verdict supplied by the caller. role: evaluated.

Retired when Tanilo's key went live; kept published so existing signatures under it can still be checked (rotation alone does not invalidate them; receipt validity, freshness and relying-party acceptance remain separate checks). From 23 June to 28 August 2026 it also signed caller-supplied bytes through routes since closed, so a signature alone does not show the service issued the payload. No role: it signed both evaluated receipts and caller-supplied bytes, so its signatures resolve to issuance-path role unknown, which is separate from signature validity.

Signed only the API gateway's withdrawn /v1/compose route (verdicts supplied by the caller). Its private key was deleted on 2026-09-24. Signatures prove the bytes are unchanged, not that anything was evaluated. role: bytes_attested.
v0.1 receipt format. Signed the attached sample receipt in the spec repo. We found no signing path for it in the current service code. No role: its full signing history is not established.
Test fixture; its private key is published in the spec repo. A signature from it proves nothing about issuance. No role: anyone can sign with it.
